_comment: Generated by countymap/scripts/build-boundaries.mjs. US counties from us-atlas (Natural Earth 1:10m, public domain); BC regional districts from DataBC (Open Government Licence – British Columbia). Boundaries only — which region an area belongs to is resolved at runtime from regions.json by shared/region-engine.js, so this file never needs regenerating when the region data changes.
